description: This Java source file defines the class PolicyModificationInvalidException, which is a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate invalid modifications to policies. It includes methods for creating instances with specific messages, JSON parsing, and a builder class for flexible construction. The class is part of the package handling policy-related exceptions and extends DittoRuntimeException.

classes.name: PolicyModificationInvalidException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a policy modification would result in an invalid policy, indicating a forbidden operation.

classes.name: PolicyModificationInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class to construct instances of PolicyModificationInvalidException with fluent API, supporting setting message, description, cause, href, and headers.

methods.name: PolicyModificationInvalidException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance with a specific message and headers.

methods.name: PolicyModificationInvalidException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance with a message, optional description, and headers.

methods.name: PolicyModificationInvalidException.fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to create a policy exception instance with headers.

methods.name: PolicyModificationInvalidException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the exception with new headers.
